status.why: EUR-Lex: 'In force: This act has been changed', consolidated version of 27/07/2026; general application since 2 August 2026 but high-risk rules now from 2 December 2027 and 2 August 2028 (Regulation 2026/1744), so 'Partially in force' holds as of today.

safety_topics.why: Six topics kept of twelve. 'evaluation & testing' (Article 55(1)(a) adversarial testing, cited in the summary) and 'deepfakes & synthetic media' (Article 50(4), cited in the summary) are supported by the stored text and would fit the summary; dropping them is defensible but not required.

summary_claims.claim: Article 55(1)(a): model evaluation including adversarial testing for providers of models with systemic risk
Article 50(2): machine-readable marking of AI-generated outputs

note: Title (full official title with the amended acts), dates, identifier, status after the AI Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, in force 27 July 2026) and the summary claims are supported by the OJ text, the Commission's AI Act page and the Omnibus text.
